blurb: Guests explore three stories of unique and strange exhibits including rare artifacts, lifelike wax figures, and interactive science displays. The attraction is wheelchair accessible and offers sensory inclusive accommodations. Group visits, private events, and birthday parties are available with special packages.
extraNote: 25% off 4-Way Combo tickets for active military, veterans, and first responders; 20% off for immediate family · AAA members receive $2 off adult tickets and $1 off child tickets at ticket counter only · Tickets do not need to be printed; accessible via phone email · Rigorous cleaning and sanitation procedures in place · Visitors assume all risks related to COVID-19 exposure · Discounted group rates available for groups of 12 or more
